title: HTML export marker file
description: The file `reqseq-html-export.yaml` that `html.export` writes into the folder of an HTML export (SR-235): it lists the files that export wrote, so the next export into the same folder replaces or removes exactly those and leaves every other file as it is. A folder that is not empty and holds no such file is never written into (SR-235 AK1). ReqSeq writes it anew on every export; it is not meant to be edited.

files.description: The files of the export, relative to its folder, with `/`, sorted by code units. An entry that names no file the export may replace (`..`, an absolute path, a name `.git` or a nested repository on its way, a symbolic link) is neither replaced nor removed (SR-235 AK2).

pending.description: Only while an export runs: the folder `.reqseq-export-staging` it writes into before the files go into place. An export that finds it left by a process that no longer runs removes it.
